card.name: Robam Trot
card.profile: Trot (Robam Trot) is a Khmer folk procession-dance performed at Khmer New Year to drive off the previous year’s bad luck. A traveling pantomime of a deer hunt, it stages the killing of a deer among ~16 characters (deer, hunter, giants, clowning Kanhche, drummers). "Trot" derives from Sanskrit "to cut off," referencing cutting the old year. Rooted in the Samre ethnic group’s pre-Indian animist tradition; eradicated under the Khmer Rouge and revived through state cultural efforts.
card.insight: Ethnologist Éveline Porée-Maspero recorded that by 1936 the trot procession had been abandoned in some Siem Reap villages — showing how close it came to loss. (Wikipedia)
